diagnostics.title: NotFound
causes: The NotFound boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Register the named Tool on the Agent builder or ToolRegistry; check the model-facing name.

diagnostics.title: InvalidInput
causes: The InvalidInput boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Validate arguments against the Tool input schema and fix the caller.

diagnostics.title: CapabilityDenied
causes: The CapabilityDenied boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Register the Tool and explicitly grant its capability to the current RunContext or child grant.

diagnostics.title: Cancelled
causes: The Cancelled boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Honor cancellation; start new work only when the caller requests it.

diagnostics.title: DeadlineExceeded
causes: The DeadlineExceeded boundary rejected the operation; inspect the safe typed error and execution state.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect deadline and retry safety before starting another invocation.

diagnostics.title: Execution

diagnostics.canonical_fix: Inspect the safe typed application cause; do not blindly retry a write.

diagnostics.title: InvalidOutput

diagnostics.canonical_fix: Return the declared output shape and preserve rich content through ToolOutput.

diagnostics.title: CapabilityDenied

diagnostics.title: Store

diagnostics.title: Validation planning failed
diagnostics.meaning: The selected source workspace or Git base could not be inspected.
causes: The working directory is not a Runifold source workspace, the base does not resolve, or required tooling is unavailable.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Select --root and --base explicitly; install Git and Python 3.11+.

diagnostics.title: Unknown task
diagnostics.meaning: The requested recipe is not in this knowledge version.
causes: Task ID spelling or knowledge version differs.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Run runifold ai context and choose a listed task.

diagnostics.title: Unknown diagnostic
diagnostics.meaning: The requested code is absent from this knowledge version.
causes: The code is misspelled or belongs to a different release or extension.
diagnostics.canonical_fix: Use documentation for the producing library version; do not guess a repair from an unrelated code.
